verses.en: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.pt: E Deus abençoou Noé e seus filhos, e disse-lhes: Frutificai, e multiplicai, e enchei a terra:
verses.en_web: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And God gave his blessing to Noah and his sons, and said, Be fertile, and have increase, and make the earth full.

verses.en: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
verses.pt: E vosso temor e vosso pavor será sobre todo animal da terra, e sobre toda ave dos céus, em tudo o que se mover na terra, e em todos os peixes do mar: em vossa mão são entregues.
verses.en_web: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.
verses.en_bbe: And the fear of you will be strong in every beast of the earth and every bird of the air; everything which goes on the land, and all the fishes of the sea, are given into your hands.

verses.en: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
verses.pt: Tudo o que se move e vive vos será para mantimento: assim como os legumes e ervas, vos dei disso tudo.
verses.en_web: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.
verses.en_bbe: Every living and moving thing will be food for you; I give them all to you as before I gave you all green things.

verses.en: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
verses.pt: Porém a carne com sua vida, que é seu sangue, não comereis.
verses.en_web: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.
verses.en_bbe: But flesh with the life-blood in it you may not take for food.

verses.en: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man’s brother will I require the life of man.
verses.pt: Porque certamente exigirei o sangue de vossas vidas; da mão de todo animal o exigirei, e da mão do ser humano; da mão do homem seu irmão exigirei a vida do ser humano.
verses.en_web: I will surely require your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.
verses.en_bbe: And for your blood, which is your life, will I take payment; from every beast I will take it, and from every man will I take payment for the blood of his brother-man.

verses.en: Whoso sheddeth man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
verses.pt: O que derramar sangue humano, pelo ser humano seu sangue será derramado; porque à imagem de Deus o ser humano foi feito.
verses.en_web: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
verses.en_bbe: Whoever takes a man's life, by man will his life be taken; because God made man in his image.

verses.en: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
verses.pt: Mas vós frutificai, e multiplicai-vos; procriai abundantemente na terra, e multiplicai-vos nela.
verses.en_web: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”
verses.en_bbe: And now, be fertile and have increase; have offspring on the earth and become great in number.

verses.en: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.pt: E falou Deus a Noé e a seus filhos com ele, dizendo:
verses.en_web: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And God said to Noah and to his sons,

verses.en: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
verses.pt: Eis que eu mesmo estabeleço meu pacto convosco, e com vossa descendência depois de vós;
verses.en_web: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,
verses.en_bbe: Truly, I will make my agreement with you and with your seed after you,

verses.en: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
verses.pt: E com toda alma vivente que está convosco, de aves, de animais, e de toda fera da terra que está convosco; desde todos os que saíram da arca até todo animal da terra.
verses.en_web: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And with every living thing with you, all birds and cattle and every beast of the earth which comes out of the ark with you.

verses.en: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
verses.pt: Estabelecerei meu pacto convosco, e não será mais exterminada toda carne com águas de dilúvio; nem haverá mais dilúvio para destruir a terra.
verses.en_web: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And I will make my agreement with you; never again will all flesh be cut off by the waters; never again will the waters come over all the earth for its destruction.

verses.en: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.pt: E disse Deus: Este será o sinal do pacto que estabeleço entre mim e vós e toda alma vivente que está convosco, por tempos perpétuos:
verses.en_web: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.en_bbe: And God said, This is the sign of the agreement which I make between me and you and every living thing with you, for all future generations:

verses.en: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
verses.pt: Meu arco porei nas nuvens, o qual será por sinal de aliança entre mim e a terra.
verses.en_web: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
verses.en_bbe: I will put my bow in the cloud and it will be for a sign of the agreement between me and the earth.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
verses.pt: E será que quando fizer vir nuvens sobre a terra, se deixará ver então meu arco nas nuvens.
verses.en_web: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,
verses.en_bbe: And whenever I make a cloud come over the earth, the bow will be seen in the cloud,

verses.en: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.pt: E me lembrarei do meu pacto, que há entre mim e vós e toda alma vivente de toda carne; e não serão mais as águas por dilúvio para destruir toda carne.
verses.en_web: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.en_bbe: And I will keep in mind the agreement between me and you and every living thing; and never again will there be a great flow of waters causing destruction to all flesh.

verses.en: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.pt: E estará o arco nas nuvens, e o verei para me lembrar do pacto perpétuo entre Deus e toda alma vivente, com toda carne que há sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And the bow will be in the cloud, and looking on it, I will keep in mind the eternal agreement between God and every living thing on the earth.

verses.en: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.pt: Disse, pois, Deus a Noé: Este será o sinal do pacto que estabeleci entre mim e toda carne que está sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And God said to Noah, This is the sign of the agreement which I have made between me and all flesh on the earth.

verses.en: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Noé que saíram da arca foram Sem, Cam e Jafé: e Cam é o pai de Canaã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Noah who went out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and Ham is the father of Canaan.

verses.en: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
verses.pt: Estes três são os filhos de Noé; e deles foi cheia toda a terra.
verses.en_web: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these, the whole earth was populated.
verses.en_bbe: These three were the sons of Noah and from them all the earth was peopled.

verses.en: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
verses.pt: E começou Noé a lavrar a terra, e plantou uma vinha;
verses.en_web: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.
verses.en_bbe: In those days Noah became a farmer, and he made a vine-garden.

verses.en: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
verses.pt: E bebeu do vinho, e se embriagou, e estava descoberto dentro de sua tenda.
verses.en_web: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.
verses.en_bbe: And he took of the wine of it and was overcome by drink; and he was uncovered in his tent.

verses.en: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
verses.pt: E Cam, pai de Canaã, viu a nudez de seu pai, e disse-o aos seus dois irmãos do lado de fora.
verses.en_web: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
verses.en_bbe: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father unclothed, and gave news of it to his two brothers outside.

verses.en: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.
verses.pt: Então Sem e Jafé tomaram a roupa, e a puseram sobre seus próprios ombros, e andando para trás, cobriram a nudez de seu pai tendo seus rostos virados, e assim não viram a nudez de seu pai.
verses.en_web: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.
verses.en_bbe: And Shem and Japheth took a robe, and putting it on their backs went in with their faces turned away, and put it over their father so that they might not see him unclothed.

verses.en: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
verses.pt: E despertou Noé de seu vinho, e soube o que havia feito com ele seu filho o mais jovem;
verses.en_web: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.
verses.en_bbe: And, awaking from his wine, Noah saw what his youngest son had done to him, and he said,

verses.en: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
verses.pt: E disse: Maldito seja Canaã; Servo de servos será a seus irmãos.
verses.en_web: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”
verses.en_bbe: Cursed be Canaan; let him be a servant of servants to his brothers.

verses.en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.pt: Disse mais: Bendito o SENHOR o Deus de Sem, E seja-lhe Canaã servo.
verses.en_web: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Praise to the Lord, the God of Shem; let Canaan be his servant.

verses.en: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.pt: Engrandeça Deus a Jafé, E habite nas tendas de Sem, E seja-lhe Canaã servo.
verses.en_web: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”
verses.en_bbe: May God make Japheth great, and let his living-place be in the tents of Shem, and let Canaan be his servant.

verses.en: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.pt: E viveu Noé depois do dilúvio trezentos e cinquenta anos.
verses.en_web: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.
verses.en_bbe: And Noah went on living three hundred and fifty years after the great flow of waters;

verses.en: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
verses.pt: E foram todos os dias de Noé novecentos e cinquenta anos; e morreu.
verses.en_web: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.
verses.en_bbe: all the years of his life were nine hundred and fifty: and he came to his end.
